references.relationship: Companion MICRA provision. §340.5 is the SOL; §3333.2 is the damages cap. Both were enacted together in 1975 as Ch. 1, 2d Ex. Sess. §340.5 canonical build lives in CA_Civil_Litigator and is cross-referenced here (not rebuilt).
Sister MICRA damages provision. §3333.1 abrogates the collateral source rule in medical malpractice cases. §3333.2 caps noneconomic damages. Together they define the MICRA damages regime.

Companion procedural provision. §364 requires 90-day pre-suit notice before commencing a MICRA action. Tolls §340.5 SOL by 90 days if notice is served within the last 90 days of the limitations period.
Attorney fee sliding-scale cap. Amended by AB 35 in parallel with §3333.2 to permit 25% of recoveries over $600,000 (up from 15%), making plaintiff representation more economically viable.

Punitive damages pleading control for healthcare provider defendants. Any punitive damages claim against a health care provider must be added via §425.13 motion showing substantial probability of prevailing.
SIRVA case law. SIRVA claims are professional negligence for administration (subject to §3333.2 cap) but may involve fraudulent concealment claims (outside cap).
